item.title: Java SDK
item.description: The Java SDK needs Java 17 or later and has no runtime dependencies. Package: io.speedle:speedle-sdk 0.1.0 on Maven Central. Reference: speedle-sdk/java. The examples check the policy described in SDKs. item.title: Python SDK
item.description: The Python SDK needs Python 3.10 or later; its only runtime dependency is httpx. It has a sync Client and an asyncio AsyncClient with the same arguments. Package: speedle 0.1.0 on PyPI. Reference: speedle-sdk/python. The examples check the policy described in SDKs. Add the dependency With pip, in a virtual environment: python3 -m venv .venv . .venv/bin/activate pip install speedle==0.1.0 Or with uv, in a uv project: uv add speedle==0.

item.title: Go SDK
item.description: The Go SDK supports the two latest Go releases and uses only the standard library. Module: github.com/teramoby/speedle-sdk/go v0.1.0, package speedle. Reference: speedle-sdk/go. The examples check the policy described in SDKs. Add the dependency In a new module: go mod init example.com/speedle-example go get github.com/teramoby/speedle-sdk/go@v0.1.0 Call a local Speedle+ Start Speedle+ and create the example policy as described in SDKs. Save this program as main.go: package main import ( "context" "fmt" "os" speedle "github.

item.title: C#/.NET SDK
item.description: The .NET SDK targets .NET 8 or later and has no dependencies. Package: Speedle.Sdk 0.1.0 on NuGet, namespace Speedle.Sdk. Reference: speedle-sdk/dotnet. The examples check the policy described in SDKs. Add the dependency In a new console project: dotnet new console -o SpeedleExample cd SpeedleExample dotnet add package Speedle.Sdk --version 0.1.0 Call a local Speedle+ Start Speedle+ and create the example policy as described in SDKs. Replace Program.cs with: using Speedle.

item.title: Rust SDK
item.description: The Rust SDK needs Rust 1.75 or later. It is async on tokio and reqwest (rustls); the blocking feature adds the blocking client used below. Crate: speedle 0.1.0 on crates.io. Reference: speedle-sdk/rust. The examples check the policy described in SDKs. Add the dependency In a new package: cargo new speedle-example cd speedle-example cargo add speedle@0.1.0 --features blocking Call a local Speedle+ Start Speedle+ and create the example policy as described in SDKs.

item.title: Node.js/TypeScript SDK
item.description: The Node.js SDK needs Node.js 22 or later, ships ESM and CommonJS builds with TypeScript types, and has no runtime dependencies. Package: @speedle/sdk 0.1.0 on npm, available when published. Reference: speedle-sdk/node. The examples check the policy described in SDKs. Add the dependency In a new ES module package (available when published): mkdir speedle-example cd speedle-example npm init -y npm pkg set type=module npm install @speedle/sdk@0.1.0 Call a local Speedle+ Start Speedle+ and create the example policy as described in SDKs.
